scientific_integrity: The short/long adversarial family and its previously known upper bound are credited to Chen and Long. The claimed additions are the sharp matching strategy, arbitrary-prior best-response formula, unique least-favourable law, and factor threshold; no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The minimax and uniqueness statements concern only the explicit 2n-input family, not arbitrary online sequences. Unindexed earlier work may exist. Finite verification does not replace general proof.
title: An exact EF1 minimax game with a unique least-favourable horizon distribution
